text: Gomɗii Alla jaɓanii tatooɓe ɓen tuubuubuyee, ɓen woni : Ka’b ibn Maalik, Maraarah ibn ar-Rabii’ e Hilaal ibn `Umayyah, ɓen leelnanooɓe jaɓaneede tuubuubuyee maɓɓe, ɓaawo nde ɓe lunndinoo yaltidugol e Nulaaɗo Alla on (yo o his) Tabuuka. Annabiijo on yamiri taƴagol ɓe, ɓe sunii ko ɓe aani fii ɗum haa leydi ndin yaajude faaɗani ɓe, ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen ɓittorii nden taƴeede, ɓe felliti wonnde moorgal woo alanaa ɓe si wanaa faade ka Alla tun. Alla yurmooɓe hawrindingol ɓe e tuubuubuuyee, refti O jaɓani ɓe tuubuubuyee. Pellet, ko Kanko woni jaɓanoowo jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen tuubuubuyee, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
